subdivision_of_building: Ground Floor rear office unit and First Floor office units
description: Change of use of part of ground floor office space and first floor office space (Use Class E) to provide four residential units (Use Class C3), together with associated cycle parking, refuse storage and amenity space.
decision_conditions: <p>Prior to the first use, the two disabled parking spaces, as shown on drawing&nbsp;PL-1126-MB-00-100, shall be installed and retained thereafter.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that adequate provision of blue badge parking is provided.</p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.295;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to the commencement of the relevant works, a policy compliant cycle parking plan,, which shows details of layout, foundation, stand type and spacing, of 2 cycle parking spaces, shall submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-a6f9949e-7fff-0869-0eec-2d6e856f5323"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.295;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure that adequate provision for the safe and secure storage of bicycles is made for future occupiers and in the interest of safeguarding highway safety.</span></p>

<p>All non-CHP space and hot water fossil fuel (or equivalent hydrocarbon based fuel) boilers must achieve dry NOx emission levels equivalent to or less than 40 mg/kWh. Evidence to demonstrate that all installed boilers meet this standard will be provided to the satisfaction of and approved in writing by the Planning Authority before occupation. Subject to written approval by the Planning Authority this condition may be discharged in agreed phases.<br><br>REASON: To ensure the acceptability of the scheme with respect to NOx pollution.<br></p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved a waste management plan outlining collection arrangements shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.&nbsp;</p><p>REASON: In the interests of providing appropriate waste collection arrangements.</p><div><br></div>

<p>The external façade, building envelope, shall be designed / refurbished to achieve and in accordance with BS8233:2014 'Guidance on sound insulation and noise reduction for buildings’ to attain the following noise levels cited in the Table below:<img src="data:image/png;base64," data-filename="image.png" style="width: 351.721px;">A&nbsp;test shall be carried out prior to the discharge of this condition to show that the required noise levels have been met and the results submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.</p><p>Reason: To obtain required sound insulation and prevent noise nuisance</p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, a landscape plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The plan should show the soft and hard surfacing proposed and include reference to plant species types and densities, surface treatments and fences and walls. It shall also include details of maintenance arrangements.&nbsp;</p><p>All planting, when approved, shall be carried out in a period of twelve months from the date on which the development on site commences or shall be carried out in the first planting (and seeding) season following the completion of the development, and shall be maintained to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority for a period of five years. Such maintenance should include the replacement of any plants that die, or are severely damaged, seriously diseased or removed.&nbsp;</p><p>REASON: In the interest of providing an acceptable level of planting for biodiversity and ecology benefits.</p><div><br></div>

<p>Prior to commencement of the development, a scheme of sound insulation measures shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council, of an enhanced sound insulation value DnT,w [and L’nT,w] of at least 5dB above the standards of Building Regulations Approved Document E ‘Resistance to the passage of sound’ for the floor/ceiling/wall structures separating different types of rooms/ uses in adjoining dwellings, namely [eg. living room and kitchen above bedroom of separate dwelling]. Approved details shall be implemented prior to occupation of the development and thereafter be permanently retained. The applicant shall provide a scheme of sound insulation that shall be submitted for approval to the Council’s Building Control Section prior to the commenced use of these residential units.</p><p>Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site is not adversely affected by noise.</p>

<p>Any plant shall be installed, together with any associated ancillary equipment, so as to prevent the transmission of noise and vibration into neighbouring premises. The rated noise level from all plant and ancillary equipment shall not increase the existing background noise level (10dB below) when measured 1m external from the nearest residential or noise sensitive premises. An assessment of the expected noise levels shall be carried out by a suitably qualified (IOA accredited) and experienced acoustic consultant, in accordance with BS 4142:2014+A1:2019 ‘Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound,’ and any mitigation measures necessary to achieve the above required noise levels shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval.</p><p>The plant shall thereafter be installed and maintained in accordance with the approved details.</p><p>Reason: To protect acceptable local noise levels.</p>
